meta.note: Per-cell regional cause multipliers. Each archetype is [Cardiovascular, Neoplasms, Chronic respiratory, complement] per age band per sex — the region's share of that stratum's deaths divided by its country's. Multiply a national cause weight by the entry for its group and renormalise. classId is aligned to rate-grid.json's cell order; -1 means no regional cause data and the national table stands.
